stylePrompt: Use the declared styleFamily for each item and choose subjects from people, communities, animals, plants, landscapes, weather, tools, vehicles, buildings and everyday objects according to the scene. Keep one coherent style inside each image while varying styles across the batch. Shared constraints: mature learner-facing art direction, landscape 3:2 composition, a clear focal action or relationship, no in-image teaching text, and no live-action or realistic-human impression. When people appear, every readable foreground or midground face must have clearly rendered natural eyes, a nose, a mouth and a scene-appropriate expression. Never use blank oval faces, featureless masks, mannequin heads or shadows that erase the facial features. Vary age, skin tone, facial structure, body type, hairstyle, clothing, ability and occupation naturally. No realistic skin pores, photographic faces, stock-photo staging, logos, watermarks, readable interfaces, chibi proportions or glossy toy rendering.

items.sentenceEn: The extended table had room for the entire family.
items.sentenceZh: 加长后的餐桌坐得下全家人。
items.scene: In a contemporary Chinese courtyard before a family meal, three adults finish sliding two clearly visible extension leaves into a wooden dining table, making it noticeably longer. Several empty chairs line the now-extended table while dishes wait on a side cart. Complete faces and natural hands handling the table safely. No antique-costume staging, readable text, logos or watermarks.
items.altText: 中国家庭院落里，几名成年人装好加长板，让餐桌明显变长。

items.sentenceEn: He manages his diabetes by checking his blood sugar regularly.
items.sentenceZh: 他通过定期检测血糖来管理糖尿病。
items.scene: At a contemporary Chinese community health clinic, an adult patient calmly uses a small finger-prick glucose meter while an adult nurse demonstrates the routine beside a plate showing balanced everyday foods. The meter screen uses simple color blocks without readable numbers. The scene communicates responsible diabetes management, not crisis or blame. Complete faces and natural hands. No needles in close-up, body horror, brand marks, text or watermarks.
items.altText: 中国社区诊所里，一名成年人在护士指导下检测血糖。

items.sentenceEn: The potter gave the wet clay a firm slap onto the wheel.
items.sentenceZh: 陶工用力把湿黏土拍到转盘上。
items.scene: In a bright pottery studio, an adult potter brings an open palm down firmly onto a lump of wet clay centered on a wheel. A small flattened splash of clay and bold motion arcs make the single slap unmistakable, while the other hand stays safely away. Complete face and natural hands. No person is struck, no injury, no readable text, logos or watermarks.
items.altText: 陶工用手掌把一团湿黏土有力地拍在转盘中央。

items.sentenceEn: The crew sealed the toxic leak before it reached the stream.
items.sentenceZh: 工作人员在有毒泄漏物流入溪流前将其封堵。
items.scene: At an industrial storage yard beside a clean stream, two adult hazardous-material workers in full protective gear clamp a leak from a damaged drum. A vivid unnatural violet liquid is contained inside a portable barrier, and nearby weeds within the barrier have wilted, signaling toxicity. Faces remain visible through clear visors with complete features. No exposed skin contact, casualties, brand labels, readable text or watermarks.
items.altText: 防护人员封堵装有紫色有毒液体的破损桶，阻止其流向溪水。

items.sentenceEn: Experts examined the alleged counterfeit painting before reaching a conclusion.
items.sentenceZh: 专家们在下结论前检查了那幅涉嫌造假的画。
items.scene: Inside a museum conservation lab, two adult experts carefully examine a questioned landscape painting under neutral light while an authenticated comparison painting rests nearby. A loose evidence folder remains closed and both experts look uncertain rather than accusatory, making clear that the claim is not proven. Complete faces and gloved natural hands. No police spectacle, guilty expression, readable labels, famous artwork, logos or watermarks.
items.altText: 博物馆实验室里，专家在尚未下结论的情况下检查一幅涉嫌造假的画。

items.sentenceEn: The dentist showed her how the jaw moves when she chews.
items.sentenceZh: 牙医向她展示咀嚼时下颌如何运动。
items.scene: In a friendly dental clinic, an adult dentist holds a large hinged anatomical model of the human lower jaw and opens it to demonstrate chewing to an adult patient. A subtle curved motion arrow follows the model's lower jaw. Both people have complete faces and natural hands; the patient gently touches the side of her own jaw. No pain, procedures, exposed tissue, readable text, logos or watermarks.
items.altText: 牙医用可活动的颌骨模型向成年患者演示下颌运动。

items.sentenceEn: The inmate learned carpentry in the prison workshop.
items.sentenceZh: 这名囚犯在监狱工坊学习木工。
items.scene: In a supervised correctional education workshop, an adult inmate in plain neutral work clothes sands a small wooden stool at a bench while an adult instructor demonstrates safe tool handling. items.scene: In a building service corridor, three adult maintenance workers actively tackle a burst water pipe: one turns the shutoff valve, one tightens a coupling with a wrench, and one positions a wide catch basin under the spray. Their coordinated actions visibly reduce the leak. Complete faces and natural hands using tools safely. No electrical hazard, panic, readable text, logos or watermarks.
items.altText: 三名维修人员分工关闭阀门、拧紧接头并接住漏水，共同解决爆管问题。

items.sentenceZh: 一位有经验的引导者改善了团队互动。

items.sentenceZh: 营地边缘那顶蓝色帐篷是我们的。
